tools.name: create_presentation
tools.description: Create an empty presentation. Select color_preset_id and font_preset_id from flamigo://themes by type. Defaults: color-navy-white, font-modern. IDs are preset slugs.

tools.name: update_presentation
tools.description: Update metadata, source, presentation_style, illustration_instruction, or independent color_preset_id/font_preset_id from flamigo://themes. Ask the user whether to refresh existing HTML after a style change. Omitted or null values leave selections unchanged. Uses the presentation revision. Does not

tools.name: create_slide
tools.description: Create a slide, optionally after an existing slide.

tools.name: update_slide
tools.description: Supply at least one update: complete slide DSL or background_image_url.

tools.name: draft_outline
tools.description: Draft a presentation-level narrative outline from the saved source.

tools.name: generate_slides_from_dsl
tools.description: Replace all slides in the presentation with the supplied complete slide DSL objects. Existing slides and their checkpoints are deleted. This clears the previous generation batch. Read /slides and render every page with has_html=false.

tools.name: generate_slides_from_outline
tools.description: Generate DSL from the reviewed outline, using its sentences as source material when the saved source is empty. Replace all slides and their checkpoints. Render each new slide afterward.

tools.name: render_slide
tools.description: Render a slide. Automatically reuse a saved layout when possible or create one when needed. Set apply_project_theme to refresh its theme. Returns the HTML resource_uri, including on replay.

tools.name: redraw_slide
tools.description: Redesign the whole slide layout from its saved content and render a new preview, replacing any manual layout.

tools.name: generate_slide_dsl
tools.description: Replace the target slide content with newly generated DSL and clear its saved layout and HTML. Render it afterward.

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.description: Read generation batch progress. Direct DSL imports have idle status. Use has_html in /slides to find missing previews and layout_content_current in slide detail to find stale previews.

tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.description: Save the current slide design as a restorable checkpoint.

tools.name: restore_checkpoint
tools.description: Restore a saved checkpoint with revision protection.

tools.name: generate_slide_alternatives
tools.description: Generate up to five variant combinations using the slide’s saved theme, preserving geometry and background. Waits for newly created choices; reuses existing choices unless fresh=true. May return pending choices from another request: read resource_uri for status. Preview ready candidates using previe

tools.name: apply_slide_alternative
tools.description: Apply a ready design choice with the batch's base_revision as expected_revision. Preserves slide content and saves the selected design and HTML. Expired choices or changes to the slide/theme require generating a new set.
